build_commands.compiler: cargo xtask runtime && cargo build --release --locked -p ms-cli
build_commands.before: ms build bench/perf/toml-quoting/main.ms --build-type Release -o before-guarded; stdlib/toml.ms at base_commit
build_commands.after: ms build bench/perf/toml-quoting/main.ms --build-type Release -o after-guarded; stdlib/toml.ms at after_toml_sha256

provenance.rust_flags: workspace .cargo/config.toml: -C force-frame-pointers=yes; Rust control opt-level=3, panic=abort; no target-cpu override
provenance.native_tools: pinned LLVM 23.1.1 O3, musl target per repository Release build; no backend override
provenance.content_guards: both producers compare every timed full output with their expected text, then accumulate byte lengths

note: Native producer timings exclude input/setup/printing. Stringify, full-output equality guard, and output release are timed. Rust may choose different equivalent TOML quoting; byte lengths are recorded independently.
